LanguageData.LP_RagePower.label: rage power
LanguageData.LP_RagePower.description: Barbarian ability power multiplier: 0.5 + Melee level / 20, plus adventurer Strength modifier × 0.05 and (proficiency bonus - 2) × 0.02; those with a martial class add 0.02 × (combined martial class levels - 1), up to +40%.
LanguageData.LP_HuntPower.label: hunter power
LanguageData.LP_HuntPower.description: Ranger ability power multiplier: 0.5 + (the higher of Shooting and Melee level) / 20, plus the adventurer's higher of Dexterity or Wisdom modifier × 0.05 and (proficiency bonus - 2) × 0.02; those with a martial class add 0.02 × (combined martial class levels - 1), up to +40%.
LanguageData.LP_CunningPower.label: cunning power
LanguageData.LP_CunningPower.description: Rogue ability power multiplier: 0.5 + (the higher of Melee and Shooting level) / 20, plus adventurer Dexterity modifier × 0.05 and (proficiency bonus - 2) × 0.02; those with a martial class add 0.02 × (combined martial class levels - 1), up to +40%.
